Appraiser remarks
The vehicle was inspected at the body shop after a collision during a left turn. The
front bumper cover is cracked across its center, the left headlamp assembly is broken,
and the hood shows a cerase that runs toward the fender. The pattern of the damage
lines up well with the impact that was described. Parts and labor were reviewed against
the invoices, which show no repeated charges. The labor hours appear slightly high for
this scope of work and should be checked with the shop. No earlier damage to the
vehicle is known. The plan is to replace the bumper cover and headlamp, repair the
hood, and refinish the affected panels.
